text: Completed in e794a4f and 3275edc. AesSpec is now the sole typed storage model; AesEnv is a compatibility alias, LayerPlan/StatPlan no longer duplicate mapping and env state, and scale/facet/row phases operate directly on the canonical mapping. Added typed lookup/update/inheritance/iteration invariants and completed CompoundPolygon coordinate traversal so the module is warning-clean. Detached-commit verification: sbt graphicsJVM/test graphicsJS/test passed 204 tests on each backend with no warnings.
